daily.headline: Smaller surf again. Extra foam likely needed. Look to the magnets for best surf.
daily.observation: Size has dropped out today. Grovel waves seen around the island. Chest/shoulder high for the exposures while smaller elsewhere. Look to the swell magnets for a playful wave but expect options and quality to be mostly limited. Clean surf for the west coast early under E winds. SEs to pick up late morning. Keep expectations mostly low for today and board volume high.

daily.headline: Small low quality, poor surf expected. Not a lot to get excited about today.
daily.observation: Low point for the week. Size looking to max out in the waist high+ range. A day for the groms, long boards or beginners. Surf clean on the west coast early but options likely looking underwhelming. Not too much on the radar but a slight bump is expected in the next couple of days.

daily.headline: Small weak low quality surf. Look to the magnets for an average wave.
daily.observation: Not too much has changed with the forecasts, as the week ahead looks a bit dull. With a lack of energy in the ocean, look to the top magnets for a grovel, while many other breaks will likely be flat/very small or just poor quality. Looks like our run of good surf may have finally come to an end as more rain activity is also on the cards. Wet season here we come.

daily.headline: Small weak low quality surf. Look to the magnets for an average wave.
daily.observation: Small surf, with a drained out low tide seen island wide this morning. Options and quality are really limited. With a lack of energy in the ocean, look to the top magnets for a grovel, while many other breaks will likely be flat/very small or just poor quality. ESE winds are up and trending. Cleanest surf at the Bukit, with surface texture elsewhere. We are expecting to see some more fun sized swell next week worth noting.

daily.headline: Slightly more size. Look to the exposures and magnets for a wave. Trades still expected.
daily.observation: A touch more energy should see a bump in size for the exposures and magnets around the region. Still, don't expect too much action, with surf likely topping out in the chest/shoulder high region for these breaks while smaller elsewhere. Trade winds are still likely trending, but most of the Bukit reefs will struggle with the lack of power. Look to the beachies on the higher tide. Probably better than the last few days, it will likely be worth a paddle.
